Call for Applications – InnoNext Financial Support to Third Parties (FSTP) for ERC and EIC Pathfinder Talents and Alumni. 

InnoNext connects European academic research with innovative start-ups and SMEs through Innovation Internships, enabling knowledge exchange and collaboration on real-world challenges. 

Two forms of support are available: 

ERC internship reimbursement of EUR 4,300/month for PhD Talents (max EUR 12,900) or EUR 5,300/month for Postdoctoral Talents (max EUR 15,900);  

EIC Pathfinder mobility allowance of EUR 2,300/month (max EUR 6,900). 

Eligible applicants include researchers currently involved in, and Alumni who previously participated in, projects funded by the European Research Council (ERC) or the European Innovation Council (EIC) Pathfinder programme. 

Financial support is subject to eligibility verification and a signed Financial Agreement. Applications and matchmaking take place through the InnoNext platform.
